context: Request: healthcare and life-sciences matters that turned on an FDA approval or clearance that had already been granted, with supporting documentation. Rubric: 1037-00003 (Solstice Biomedical, 510(k) K232847) and a proof document; the precision criterion permits only 1037-00003 and 1018-00005.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Four whole-store globs (all files and three file types; one type returns nothing).

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: Lists the store folder, then all matter folder names.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Two store-wide extraction scripts with broad terms and no output cap; they return about 1.1M and 7M chars and the run stops with the context full, before any response is written.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → List matter folders → Scan document text with an extraction script
runs.failure_point: Two uncapped store-wide scans filled the context; no response.md was produced.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.why: Ran a store-wide scan with common terms and no output cap; after it returned about 1.1M chars it reran with terms still broad, and the ~7M-char output overflowed the context before any response was written.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus a shell find (empty).

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Content-mode grep for the request words over the whole store; hit lines span many matters, some of them binary noise.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads a diligence report and three emails from two matters with grep hits.

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Shell grep over emails for the agency name near approval words; lists a few matters.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads four emails from two matters on that list.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: Grep within one candidate matter's emails.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Globs all files of one candidate matter.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads a memo and a report of that matter; a guessed engagement-letter path in a second matter does not exist.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Globs all files of the second matter.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads three memos of the second matter.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes one clear match and the second matter as a qualified match whose own product was still awaiting a decision, by reading the request broadly.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Search file contents for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Search file contents for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Search within a candidate matter's files → List files in candidate matters → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → List files in candidate matters → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: It found and documented the qualifying matter but also asserted a matter whose product was still pending, on a broad reading of the request.

first_error.why: Having read that the second matter's own device was still awaiting a decision, it still listed that matter as a qualifying (if qualified) match on the strength of earlier grants its analysis cited.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Two shell finds return nothing; checks the working folder, then lists the first 200 files.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: Lists all matter folder names.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script writing to a file: a heredoc error, then a rerun that times out with no output.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: find | grep over file paths for regulatory and industry words; about 120 paths.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads four memos and a draft letter from three matters on that list.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Splits the matter folders into four lists (one heredoc error), runs four parallel extraction scripts for approval phrases, then filters the 1,886-line output by path words.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads regulatory memos from five matters picked from the filtered output.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists all files of six candidate matters.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads a term sheet, a license, a memo and an engagement letter of one more matter.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes four matters as qualifying.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → List matter folders → Scan document text with an extraction script → Search file names for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → List files in candidate matters → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: It found and documented the qualifying matter but also asserted two other matters on a broad reading of the request.

first_error.why: It asserted four matters as qualifying, two of which the request did not cover, applying a broad reading of work that turned on an existing grant after short reads of their memos.

divergence: All three runs failed. T0 ran two uncapped store-wide scans and the context filled before any response (context overflow at the scan stage). T1 and T2 both found and documented the qualifying matter but also asserted other matters on a broad reading of the request (over-inclusion at the write stage): T1 one matter whose own product was still pending, T2 two further matters.
